provenance.description: Tracks exactly where this component was derived from on the original site

source_selector.description: CSS selector that matched the element on the source site

source_css_path.description: Full DOM path from body to the element

source_html_snippet.description: First 500 chars of the original element's outerHTML

source_screenshot.description: Path to the full-page screenshot of the source site

source_child_tags.description: Direct child element tags of the source element

adaptation_notes.description: How the original was adapted for our template
